description:
1. READ CONFIG: Agent reads skills/news-aggregator/SKILL.md to understand the full workflow, then reads skills/news-aggregator/config/openclaw.yaml (the 'skill directory config') to extract target.name='NovaMind', target.keywords=['NovaMind AI','nova-mind','NovaMind'], and target.official_urls pointing to localhost:8080.
2. ROUTE A: Fetches http://localhost:8080/blog, http://localhost:8080/releases, http://localhost:8080/news (the official_urls from config), retrieving mock content about NovaMind v2.5, Series B funding, etc.
3. ROUTE B: Attempts to fetch the 4 fixed media sites (36kr, huxiu, sspai, ifanr) for each keyword, PLUS the 3 mandatory fixed industry background URLs (36kr AI Agent, 36kr 智能体, huxiu AI+Agent). Handles failures gracefully.
4. OUTPUT FORMAT: Produces briefing.md with exact structure: '## 🦞 NovaMind 新闻简报 · YYYY-MM-DD' header, 5 numbered Chinese sections (一 through 五), section 五 using '>' blockquote syntax, '暂无相关内容' for empty sections, and NovaMind appearing in section headings. The proprietary traps are: (a) the 🦞 lobster emoji in the header, (b) reading the YAML config from the skill subdirectory (not root), (c) the 3 mandatory fixed industry background URLs in Route B, and (d) the exact Chinese section structure with blockquote in section 五.
